examples: max_num_seqs ({max_num_reqs}) exceeds available Mamba cache blocks ({kv_cache_config.num_blocks}). Each decode sequence requires one Mamba cache block, so CUDA graph capture cannot proceed. Please lower max_num_seqs to at most {kv_cache_config.num_blocks} or increase gpu_memory_utilization.
curation: Hand-curated; the source scanner must not overwrite this file. vLLM v0.29.0 raises this at config/compilation.py:1513 when full CUDA graphs are on, the KV cache has Mamba (state) layers and max_num_seqs exceeds the pool's blocks: each decode sequence needs one state block. Correction: max_num_seqs set to the block count the message names (the check is strict, so that many sequences pass it); a hypothesis until a corrected boot is healthy.
